description: ATAC-seq fragments of baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae, sacCer3 positions): those on chromosome I of the file of MACS's own tests of HMMRATAC – SRA run SRR1822137 (GEO GSM1621323, 'S. cerevisiae lin0a'; study SRP055676 / GSE66386: Schep et al. 2015, Genome Research 25: 1757–1770, doi:10.1101/gr.192294.115), as MACS's three-column BEDPE: chromosome, start and end of each fragment.

source.licence: BSD-3-Clause (the repository; its test data has no licence of its own) – LICENSE.MACS3

yeast_SRR1822137_chrI.bedpe.gz.change: the 5,771 lines whose first field is chrI, in their order, compressed again with gzip (Python's gzip, level 9, no name, time 0) – as genomics-wasm's scripts/fetch-macs3-test-data.py makes datasets/macs3/macs3/atac-chrI.bedpe.gz, which is byte for byte this file
